# Shilp Sahayak workspace guidance

- Keep this project a frontend-only React prototype. Never add backend services or real AI, voice recognition, payment, GeM, or ONDC integrations.
- Keep interface copy simple, visual, accessible, mobile-first, and friendly to Hindi-speaking artisans.
- Preserve the warm terracotta, cream, brown, and muted-green design system.
- Persist artisan-created products and editable profile preferences in localStorage; keep seeded data in `src/data/artisanData.js`.
- Use React Router for pages and Lucide React for interface icons. Build and lint the project after code changes.
